description.value:
You can temporarily download additional skills from the infosphere or an external memory unit. During your daily preparations, you become trained in one skill of your choice. This proficiency lasts until you prepare again. Since this proficiency is temporary, you can't use it as a prerequisite for a skill increase or a permanent character option like a feat.

At 9th level, you become an expert in the chosen skill. At 17th level, you instead become a master in the chosen skill.
